author: Clifton Robbins
text: Professional team, competitive prices, flawless execution, what more could you ask for?  How about quick turn around?  Well they did that too!  Called on a Saturday with a hot water heater that had completely failed after a 17 year life and it was replaced the following Monday morning.  On top of that, they updated the system by adding a flow thermal surge tank that resolved the banging PEX that had developed inside the walls over the years.  Call these guys if you want it done right!

author: Bradley Brown
text:
Jacob B. with Stine-Nichols was professional, direct, and most important — honest. He talked us through every step and made sure we understood what he needed to do in order to track, diagnose, and fix our plumbing issues.

He did not do anything without communicating it to us first and getting our verbal permission.

We will definitely be using their services again if we need plumbing services.

author: Matt
text: Wow, talk about fast and efficient! We had a break in the water pipeline that feeds our business. Jacob, our technician, was professional and made sure the job was done right. Stine Nichols is top-notch, and we highly recommend them for providing you service.

author: JD Kearns
text: Had a good experience. The line from the house was blocked 44 feet out.  The cost was fair for the going rates and I had peace of mind knowing the job was done right by a pro. The technician was knowledgeable and had it fixed in good time.

author: Tami Collins
text: Jacob Brown did some plumbing for me. He was friendly,quick, knowledgeable. Explained things to me so I understood what was wrong and what he needed to do. Price was fair and appropriate.
